tests.title: New with a key and a non-empty model id returns a client and the exported constants hold their values
given: a core.Model with ID "vendor/model"
Options.Env holds OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL pointing at a recording server
then: the client is non-nil and the error is nil
the recording server has received 0 requests
API == "openrouter-chat", APIKeyVar == "OPENROUTER_API_KEY", BaseURLVar == "OPENROUTER_BASE_URL"
DefaultBaseURL == "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1" and DefaultMaxRetries == 2
tests.pseudocode: c, err := New(m, Options{Env: env}); assert err == nil && c != nil; assert srv.Count() == 0; assert constants

tests.title: Variables resolve Env first, then Getenv, then process env, with empty values unset, and only the two OPENROUTER names are looked up
given: a recording Getenv that logs every name asked
Getenv returns key "from-getenv"; Env sets OPENROUTER_API_KEY "from-env"
a second case where Env holds an empty key and Getenv returns a key
a third case with Getenv nil and the key in the process environment (t.Setenv)
tests.when: New is called and one request is made in each case
then: case 1 sends Authorization: Bearer from-env
case 2 falls through the empty Env value and sends the Getenv key
case 3 uses the process environment
every name the recorder saw is OPENROUTER_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_BASE_URL
tests.pseudocode: for each case: New; Stream; read to end; assert srv.Last().Header("Authorization"); assert set(logged) ⊆ {APIKeyVar, BaseURLVar}

tests.title: A missing or empty API key fails New with ErrNoAPIKey naming the variable and no request is made
given: Env without OPENROUTER_API_KEY and a Getenv returning empty
a recording server as OPENROUTER_BASE_URL
tests.when: New is called, and again with the key set to the empty string
then: the client is nil
errors.Is(err, openrouter.ErrNoAPIKey) is true
err.Error() contains "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"
the recording server received 0 requests
tests.pseudocode: c, err := New(m, opts); assert c == nil; assert errors.Is(err, ErrNoAPIKey); assert contains(err.Error(), "OPENROUTER_API_KEY"); assert srv.Count()==0

tests.title: A malformed OPENROUTER_BASE_URL fails New naming the variable and showing the value without user-info
given: the key is set
base URLs: "not a url", "ftp://host/x", "/relative", "ftp://user:secret@host/x"
tests.when: New is called with each base URL
then: the client is nil
the error text contains "OPENROUTER_BASE_URL" and the configured value
for the user-info case the text contains neither "user:secret" nor "secret"
no request is made
tests.pseudocode: for u in urls: c, err := New(m, Options{Env: {key, BaseURLVar: u}}); assert c==nil; assert contains(err, BaseURLVar); assert !contains(err, "secret")

tests.title: An empty model id fails New
given: a core.Model with ID ""
the key is set
then: the client is nil and the error is non-nil
no request is made
tests.pseudocode: c, err := New(core.Model{}, opts); assert c == nil && err != nil

tests.title: Requests are POSTs to <base>/chat/completions with only a Bearer header carrying the key, and the default base URL is openrouter.ai/api/v1
given: a recording HTTPClient transport that records method, host, path and headers and returns a canned SSE body without touching the network
a recording httptest server used with a base URL ending in "//"
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OLLAMA_HOST set in the process environment
tests.when: Stream is run to completion with OPENROUTER_BASE_URL unset, and again against the httptest server
then: the transport sees POST, host openrouter.ai, path /api/v1/chat/completions
the server case sees path /chat/completions after trailing slashes are trimmed
Authorization is exactly "Bearer <key>"
the key, ANTHROPIC_* and OLLAMA_* values appear in no body and in no other header
tests.pseudocode: assert rec.Method=="POST"; assert rec.Host=="openrouter.ai"; assert rec.Path=="/api/v1/chat/completions"; assert !bodyContains(key) && !headersExceptAuthContain(key)

tests.title: Stream refuses an already-cancelled context without making a request
given: a provider against a recording server
a context cancelled before the call
then: the returned channel is nil
the returned error is ctx.Err() (context.Canceled)
the recording server received 0 requests
tests.pseudocode: ch, err := c.Stream(cancelled, req); assert ch == nil; assert errors.Is(err, context.Canceled); assert srv.Count()==0

tests.title: Concurrent Stream calls on one provider each complete independently and race-free
given: one provider value against a recording server replaying a canned text stream
16 goroutines
tests.when: every goroutine calls Stream and drains its channel (run under -race)
then: each channel closes after its own MessageEndEvent
each result carries a final message with the canned text and nil Err
no data race is reported
tests.pseudocode: parallel 16x { ch := Stream(); events := drain(ch); assert last(events) is MessageEndEvent }

tests.title: The body carries the model id as written, stream flags, and one joined leading system message
given: m.ID "Vendor/Model:Free-v1.2"
Request.System of two text blocks "A" and "B"
a second request with no system text
tests.when: Stream is run against the recording server for each request
then: body.model equals the id byte for byte
body.stream is true and body.stream_options.include_usage is true
messages[0] is role system with content "A\n\nB"
the second body has no system message
tests.pseudocode: assert body.model==m.ID; assert body.stream_options.include_usage; assert body.messages[0]=={role:system, content:"A\n\nB"}; assert count(role==system)<=1

tests.title: Prefix then messages are encoded in order; text-less user messages skipped; each tool result is its own tool message; no cache_control
given: a Prefix with one user message
Messages holding a text-less user message, an assistant call, two tool results (one IsError) and a final user message
tests.when: Stream is run against the recording server
then: roles appear in the order prefix, then messages
the text-less user message is absent
each tool result is a separate tool message with tool_call_id equal to the call id
the error result's content starts with "Error: " and equals provider.ToolResultText
the body contains no cache_control
tests.pseudocode: assert roles(body.messages)==[...]; assert body.messages[k].content==provider.ToolResultText(v); assert !contains(rawBody, "cache_control")

tests.title: Assistant messages replay arguments byte for byte and skip empty assistant messages
given: an assistant message with text and a tool call whose Input is {"b": 1,  "a":[1, 2]} with odd whitespace and key order
an assistant message with no text, no tool calls and no reasoning
an assistant message with only tool calls
tests.when: Stream is run against the recording server
then: the tool call has id, type "function", function.name and function.arguments byte-identical to string(Input)
content is absent for the tool-only message
the empty assistant message is not sent
tests.pseudocode: assert body.messages[i].tool_calls[0].function.arguments == string(input)

tests.title: Tools are declared with their full schema as MarshalJSON renders it, nil schema as empty object, and no strict flag
given: a tool whose schema has properties in non-alphabetical order, additionalProperties false, a format and min/max bounds
a tool with a nil schema
tests.when: Stream is run against the recording server
then: tools[0].function.parameters bytes equal schema.MarshalJSON output
tools[1].function.parameters is {"type":"object","properties":{}}
each entry has type "function" and name/description
no tool object contains a strict key
tests.pseudocode: want,_ := s.MarshalJSON(); assert rawParams(0)==want; assert json(rawParams(1))=={type:object,properties:{}}; assert !contains(rawTools,"strict")

tests.title: Tool choice auto and none are sent and unset is omitted
given: requests with ToolChoiceAuto, ToolChoiceNone and ToolChoiceUnset
tests.when: each is streamed against the recording server
then: tool_choice is "auto", "none", and absent respectively
tests.pseudocode: assert body.tool_choice == "auto"; assert body.tool_choice == "none"; assert !has(body,"tool_choice")

tests.title: max_completion_tokens is capped by the model's output cap, defaults to it, or is omitted
tests.when: each request is streamed against the recording server
then: recorded values are 131072, 4096, 32768, absent, 4096
tests.pseudocode: table-driven; assert body["max_completion_tokens"] equals expected or key absent

tests.title: temperature, top_p and stop are sent when set, including zero, and omitted otherwise
given: Temperature pointer to 0.0, TopP pointer to 0.0, StopSequences ["END"]
a request with nil pointers and empty StopSequences
then: the first body has temperature 0, top_p 0 and stop ["END"]
the second body has none of temperature, top_p, stop
tests.pseudocode: assert has(body,"temperature") && body.temperature==0; assert !has(body2,"stop")

tests.title: Empty effort sends no reasoning, nil map sends the name, an absent or nil map entry sends nothing
given: Efforts nil with effort "high"
Efforts {low,medium,high,max} with effort "xhigh"
Efforts with a nil entry for "low"
empty Request.Effort
then: empty effort: no reasoning key
nil map: reasoning.effort == "high"
absent level: no reasoning key
nil entry: no reasoning key
tests.pseudocode: assert !has(body,"reasoning") for 3 cases; assert body.reasoning.effort=="high"

tests.title: Numeric effort values go to reasoning.max_tokens, names to reasoning.effort, nothing is clamped or removes sampling
given: Efforts map value "8192" for "high" and "medium" for "low"
a request with Effort "max" mapped to "max", Temperature 0.3, TopP 0.9
then: "8192" records reasoning.max_tokens 8192 and no reasoning.effort
"medium" records reasoning.effort "medium" and no max_tokens
"max" records reasoning.effort "max", temperature 0.3 and top_p 0.9
tests.pseudocode: assert body.reasoning.max_tokens==8192 && !has(body.reasoning,"effort")

tests.title: The shared repair drops errored/aborted turns and orphan results, inserts synthetic results in position, and leaves its input untouched
given: an assistant message with StopReasonError and its tool result
an assistant message with StopReasonAborted
a kept assistant message with calls A, B, C and a result only for B, followed by a user message
a deep copy of the input taken before the call
tests.when: the provider repair function is called
then: errored and aborted assistant messages are gone and the orphan result is gone
the results after the kept turn are A (synthetic, IsError, text "No result provided"), B, C (synthetic) before the user message
the report counts the dropped assistants, dropped orphans and inserted results
the input is deep-equal to its copy
tests.pseudocode: out, rep := provider.RepairToolPairing(in); assert deepEqual(in, copy); assert ids(results(out))==[A,B,C]; assert rep.Inserted==2

tests.title: Repaired transcripts pair every call exactly once, keep thinking intact and are a fixed point
given: generated transcripts mixing errored, aborted, answered and unanswered assistant turns, with thinking blocks and orphan results
tests.when: for any generated transcript the repair is applied, then applied to its own output
then: every tool call of a kept assistant message is followed by exactly one result with its id before the next non-result message
every thinking block in the output is equal to its input counterpart
the second pass reports zero changes and returns an equal transcript
tests.pseudocode: for t in gen(): o,_ := Repair(t); assert paired(o); assert thinkingEqual(o,t); o2,r2 := Repair(o); assert !r2.Changed() && equal(o,o2)

tests.title: Stream repairs prefix and history and reports non-zero counts through Warnf only
given: a prefix with an unanswered tool call
history with an errored assistant turn
a clean second request
a recording Warnf
tests.when: Stream is run for the broken request and then for the clean request
then: Warnf is called once for the repaired prefix and once for the repaired history
the recorded body holds the repaired transcript
Warnf is not called for the clean request
tests.pseudocode: assert len(warns)==2 after req1; assert len(warns)==2 after req2

tests.title: Tool-call ids from another provider pass through unchanged
given: an assistant message from a different model with tool call id "toolu_01abc" and its result
tests.when: Stream is run against the recording server
then: tool_calls[0].id and the tool message's tool_call_id are both "toolu_01abc"
tests.pseudocode: assert body.messages[1].tool_calls[0].id=="toolu_01abc"; assert body.messages[2].tool_call_id=="toolu_01abc"

tests.title: reasoning_details replays the concatenated fragments for same-model messages only, ignoring empty or non-array signatures
given: a same-model assistant message with two thinking blocks whose Signatures are JSON arrays with extra fields, plus a third block with Signature "" and a fourth with "not json"
a message from another model with a signed thinking block
tests.when: Stream is run against the recording server
then: the same-model message's reasoning_details equals the fragments in block order, each element JSON-equivalent with every field
the empty and invalid Signatures contribute nothing
the other-model message has no reasoning_details key
tests.pseudocode: assert jsonEqual(body.messages[1].reasoning_details, concat(sig1, sig2)); assert !has(body.messages[3],"reasoning_details")

tests.title: Thinking text never appears in any content field
given: same-model and other-model assistant messages with thinking text "UNIQUE-MARKER-7f3"
tests.when: Stream is run against the recording server
then: no content in the recorded body contains the marker
an assistant message holding only thinking text and no signature is skipped
tests.pseudocode: for m in body.messages: assert !contains(m.content, MARKER)

tests.title: One MessageStartEvent per turn, even across a retried attempt, with model, effort and timestamp
given: a recording server answering 503 first and then a successful stream
Options.Now returning a fixed time, Retry-After: 0
Request.Effort "low"
tests.when: the turn is streamed and drained
then: exactly one MessageStartEvent precedes every content event
the partial message has Model m.ID, Effort "low" and the fixed Timestamp
the server received 2 requests
tests.pseudocode: assert count(events, MessageStartEvent)==1; assert index(start) < index(firstContent)

tests.title: Block indices follow order of first appearance and ignorable input produces no events
given: an SSE body with keep-alive comments ": OPENROUTER PROCESSING", a role-only delta, an empty delta and a choice with index 1, between reasoning, text and tool-call deltas
tests.when: the body is decoded, then decoded again with the ignorable lines removed
then: block 0 is thinking, block 1 text, block 2 tool call
both runs yield identical event sequences
no event derives from the index-1 choice
tests.pseudocode: assert types(events)==[Start, ThinkStart(0), ThinkDelta(0), TextStart(1), ...]; assert equal(events, eventsClean)

tests.title: delta.content emits a TextStart then TextDelta events with the open block's index
given: an SSE body with content deltas "Hel" and "lo"
then: one TextStartEvent then TextDeltaEvents with Delta "Hel" and "lo" at the same BlockIndex
TextEndEvent carries "Hello"
tests.pseudocode: assert deltas==["Hel","lo"]; assert end.Text=="Hello"

tests.title: Reasoning fragments accumulate as the thinking block's Signature array and visible text, never as text events
given: chunks with delta.reasoning plus reasoning_details fragments carrying extra fields (id, format, index)
a chunk with only reasoning.text, reasoning.summary and reasoning.encrypted fragments and no delta.reasoning
then: ThinkingStart and ThinkingDelta events are emitted, no text events for them
the finished ThinkingBlock.Thinking is the accumulated text (summary and text fragments counted, encrypted adding none)
Signature is the JSON array of all fragments in arrival order with every field
Redacted is false; with no fragments Signature is empty
tests.pseudocode: assert jsonEqual(block.Signature, fragments); assert block.Thinking=="..."; assert !block.Redacted

tests.title: Tool-call fragments accumulate by index, arguments are concatenated byte for byte and id-less calls get unique ids
given: two interleaved tool calls split over several fragments with whitespace-bearing arguments
two calls without ids in one turn
a call with empty arguments
then: ToolCallStartEvent is emitted at the first fragment carrying id and name
each arguments fragment is a ToolInputDeltaEvent as received
final ToolUseBlock.Input equals the concatenated bytes
id-less calls get distinct ids matching ^call_[0-9a-f]+$
empty arguments yield {}
tests.pseudocode: assert string(block.Input)==join(fragments); assert ids[0]!=ids[1]; assert match("^call_[0-9a-f]+$", ids[0])

tests.title: Non-object tool arguments become {} and Warnf names the call
given: a call id "call_x" name "read" with arguments "[1,2" or "\"str\""
a recording Warnf
then: ToolUseBlock.Input is {}
a Warnf line contains "call_x" and "read"
tests.pseudocode: assert string(block.Input)=="{}"; assert contains(warns[0], "call_x") && contains(warns[0], "read")

tests.title: After finish_reason reading continues to collect usage, then block ends in order and the MessageEnd carry the final message
given: a body with text, a tool call, a finish chunk, then a usage chunk with empty choices, then [DONE]
then: TextEnd, ToolCallEnd arrive once each in block order, with whole blocks
MessageEndEvent follows them
the result message equals the MessageEndEvent message with nil Err
usage from the later chunk is present in the message
tests.pseudocode: assert order(events)==[...,TextEnd(0),ToolCallEnd(1),MessageEnd]; assert res.Message==end.Message; assert res.Message.Usage.Reported()

tests.title: Every finish_reason maps to its stop reason, is kept raw, tool calls survive, and response id and model are set
given: streams ending with stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter and an unknown value "weird"
a stream with a tool call and finish_reason "stop"
chunks carrying id "gen-1" and model "vendor/served"
then: stop→Stop, length→Length, tool_calls→ToolUse, content_filter→Refusal, weird→Stop
RawStopReason equals the raw value
the tool-call-with-stop message keeps its ToolUseBlock
ResponseID is "gen-1" and ResponseModel "vendor/served"
tests.pseudocode: table-driven over finish reasons; assert msg.StopReason==want && msg.RawStopReason==raw

tests.title: A body ending without finish_reason fails with ErrStreamTruncated and keeps no tool call
given: a body with text and a partial tool call, ending after [DONE] or EOF without any finish_reason
then: result Err satisfies errors.Is(err, openrouter.ErrStreamTruncated)
the error text is "openrouter: stream ended before finish_reason"
the message has StopReasonError and no ToolUseBlock
tests.pseudocode: assert errors.Is(res.Err, ErrStreamTruncated); assert res.Err.Error()=="openrouter: stream ended before finish_reason"; assert len(ExtractToolUse(msg))==0

tests.title: An in-stream 429 or 5xx before content discards the attempt and retries
given: the first 200 stream is an error chunk code 429 (or 502) with no content, with Retry-After: 0
the second response is a good stream
then: the server received 2 requests
the consumer sees events only from the second attempt
the final message is the good one with nil Err
tests.pseudocode: assert srv.Count()==2; assert noEventsFrom(attempt1)

tests.title: An in-stream error after content, with a non-retryable code, or with retries exhausted fails as a StatusError
given: a stream with text then an error chunk code 429
a stream with an error chunk code 400 and no content
a stream with an error chunk code 503 and MaxRetries 0
then: each server receives exactly 1 request
Err is a *openrouter.StatusError with Code equal to the vendor's code (429, 400, 503)
Text is "openrouter: error <code> in stream: <message>"
a choice with finish_reason "error" is treated the same way
tests.pseudocode: var se *StatusError; assert errors.As(res.Err,&se); assert se.Code==429; assert se.Text=="openrouter: error 429 in stream: slow down"

tests.title: A failed turn keeps text and thinking, drops tool calls, keeps usage, and ends ErrorEvent then MessageEnd then result
given: a stream with thinking, text, a complete tool call, a usage chunk and then an in-stream error code 400 after content
then: the message has StopReasonError, ErrorMessage equal to the error text, the text and thinking blocks and no tool-call block
core.ExtractToolUse(message) returns no calls
usage that had arrived is on the message and priced
the last two events are ErrorEvent{Terminal: true} then MessageEndEvent
result Err equals the ErrorEvent's Err
tests.pseudocode: assert last2(events)==[ErrorEvent(Terminal), MessageEnd]; assert res.Err==errEvent.Err; assert msg.ErrorMessage==res.Err.Error()

tests.title: 429 and 5xx are retried up to MaxRetries, with default 2, 0 and negative meaning none
given: a server that answers 503 with Retry-After: 0 on every request
a server answering 429 then 200
tests.when: default options, MaxRetries 0, MaxRetries -1 and MaxRetries 1 are exercised
then: default: exactly 3 requests and the turn fails
MaxRetries 0 and -1: exactly 1 request
429 followed by 200 succeeds on the second request
tests.pseudocode: assert srv.Count()==3; assert srv0.Count()==1

tests.title: Wait honours Retry-After seconds or date in 0–60 s, otherwise follows the 0.5 s–8 s jittered curve
given: the unexported backoff hook recording each wait
responses with Retry-After: 0, 5, an HTTP date 3 s ahead (via Options.Now), 120 and none
then: Retry-After 0 waits zero, 5 waits 5 s, the date waits about 3 s
120 and absent fall back to 0.5 s, 1 s, 2 s … capped at 8 s with up to 25% jitter
the 60 s boundary is honoured, 61 s is not
tests.pseudocode: assert wait(ra="0")==0; assert wait(ra="120") in [0.5,0.625]; assert wait(attempt=10) <= 8*1.25

tests.title: Exhausted retries end the turn with the last status error
given: a server answering 503 then 502 then 429 with Retry-After: 0 and default retries
then: Err is a *StatusError with Code 429 (the last)
the message has StopReasonError
the server received 3 requests
tests.pseudocode: assert se.Code==429; assert msg.StopReason==StopReasonError

tests.title: HTTP 401 and 403 fail at once with a StatusError naming OPENROUTER_API_KEY
given: a server answering 401 (and in a second case 403) with error.message "bad key"
then: the server received 1 request
Err is a *StatusError with Code 401 (403)
Text starts with "openrouter: HTTP 401: bad key" and mentions OPENROUTER_API_KEY
tests.pseudocode: assert srv.Count()==1; assert se.Code==401; assert hasPrefix(se.Text,"openrouter: HTTP 401: bad key") && contains(se.Text,"OPENROUTER_API_KEY")

tests.title: Other non-2xx statuses fail without retry using error.message as the vendor message
given: servers answering 400 and 402 with a JSON error.message, and one with a non-JSON body
then: each server received 1 request
Err is a *StatusError with the status code and Text "openrouter: HTTP <code>: <message>"
the non-JSON body case still yields a StatusError with that code
tests.pseudocode: assert se.Text=="openrouter: HTTP 402: insufficient credits"; assert srv.Count()==1

tests.title: A transport failure is not retried and fails as "openrouter: <error>"
given: a base URL pointing at a closed port, or an HTTPClient returning an error
then: exactly one attempt is made
Err text starts with "openrouter: "
the message has StopReasonError
tests.pseudocode: assert hasPrefix(res.Err.Error(),"openrouter: "); assert attempts==1

tests.title: Cancelling the context during the request, mid-stream or during a retry wait aborts the turn within 1 s
given: a server that hangs before responding
a server that sends text then stalls
a server answering 503 with Retry-After: 60 so the provider is waiting
tests.when: the caller's context is cancelled in each case
then: the channel closes within 1 second
the message has StopReasonAborted and ErrorMessage "Request was aborted"
errors.Is(res.Err, core.ErrAborted) is true
tests.pseudocode: cancel(); assert closedWithin(1s); assert msg.StopReason==StopReasonAborted; assert errors.Is(res.Err, core.ErrAborted)

tests.title: No output the provider builds contains the API key
given: generated API keys of varied length and characters
a server whose error.message, in-stream error message and tool-call name echo the key, and a base URL containing the key as a path segment
a recording Warnf
tests.when: for any generated key, turns are run through HTTP errors, in-stream errors, transport errors and bad tool arguments
then: no Err string, ErrorEvent, ErrorMessage, event field or Warnf line contains the key
the key is replaced by "[redacted]" where it was echoed
tests.pseudocode: for k in gen(): run scenarios; assert all(!contains(s,k) for s in collectedStrings); assert contains(errText,"[redacted]")

tests.title: Usage 354/256/120/80 with cost 0.00012 is netted into core.Usage
given: a usage chunk prompt_tokens 354, cached_tokens 256, completion_tokens 120, reasoning_tokens 80, total_tokens 474, cost 0.00012
a second chunk reporting cache_write_tokens 50
a third chunk reporting only prompt_tokens and completion_tokens
then: first: InputTokens 98, CacheReadTokens 256, OutputTokens 120, ReasoningTokens 80, TotalTokens 474, CostUSD 0.00012 with UsageCostUSD set
second: CacheWriteTokens 50 and InputTokens 48
third: presence bits set for exactly input and output tokens
tests.pseudocode: assert usage==core.Usage{InputTokens:98,CacheReadTokens:256,OutputTokens:120,ReasoningTokens:80,...}; assert usage.Has(UsageCostUSD)

tests.title: Usage netting never goes negative and conserves totals
given: generated non-negative prompt, cached, cache-write, completion and reasoning counts, including cached greater than prompt and reasoning greater than completion
tests.when: for any such counts the usage chunk is decoded
then: InputTokens >= 0
ReasoningTokens <= OutputTokens
InputTokens + CacheReadTokens + CacheWriteTokens == max(prompt_tokens, CacheReadTokens + CacheWriteTokens)
tests.pseudocode: for c in gen(): u := decode(c); assert u.InputTokens>=0 && u.ReasoningTokens<=u.OutputTokens; assert u.Input+u.CacheRead+u.CacheWrite==max(c.prompt, c.cached+c.write)

tests.title: Requests is 1 across retries and BilledModel records a differing served model
given: a server answering 503 twice with Retry-After: 0 then a good stream whose chunks carry model "vendor/other-served"
then: Usage.Requests == 1
BilledModel is "vendor/other-served"
with the served model equal to m.ID BilledModel stays empty
tests.pseudocode: assert msg.Usage.Requests==1; assert msg.Usage.BilledModel=="vendor/other-served"

tests.title: Cost comes from the reported value, else the row's price, else stays unset
given: a priced model and usage reporting cost 0.5
a priced model and usage with no cost
a model with all prices zero and usage with no cost
then: case 1: CostUSD 0.5 with the bit set
case 2: CostUSD == provider.ComputeCost(&m, usage) with the bit set
case 3: CostUSD 0 and Has(UsageCostUSD) false
a reported cost wins even for a zero-price model
tests.pseudocode: assert u.CostUSD==0.5 && u.Has(UsageCostUSD); assert u.CostUSD==provider.ComputeCost(&m,u); assert !u.Has(UsageCostUSD)

tests.title: A response with no usage leaves usage unreported and unpriced
given: a good stream with finish_reason stop and no usage chunk, for a priced model
then: Usage.Reported() is false
CostUSD is 0 and its bit is clear
tests.pseudocode: assert !msg.Usage.Reported(); assert !msg.Usage.Has(UsageCostUSD)

tests.title: go.mod pins the SDK at v0.9.66 directly and the allowlist carries it with a reason comment
given: the root go.mod and internal/policy/deps_test.go sources
tests.when: the policy tests parse go.mod and approvedDeps
then: github.com/OpenRouterTeam/go-sdk is required at exactly v0.9.66 without // indirect
approvedDeps contains the module with a comment on the preceding line
the pin test fails if the version or the indirect marker changes
tests.pseudocode: assert require["github.com/OpenRouterTeam/go-sdk"]=="v0.9.66" && !indirect; assert commentedDeps passes

tests.title: Only provider/openrouter imports the SDK in any module
given: go list import graphs of the root and every module in MODULES
tests.when: the policy test scans every package's imports
then: the only package importing github.com/OpenRouterTeam/go-sdk or a subpackage is provider/openrouter
tests.pseudocode: for pkg in goListAll(): if importsSDK(pkg): assert pkg.ImportPath endswith "provider/openrouter"

tests.title: Root graph snapshot and direct set accept exactly the SDK's modules
given: preSpec13Direct including the SDK
the regenerated testdata/go-list-m-all.txt
then: root direct set equals preSpec13Direct sorted
go list -m all equals the snapshot
